about: The Secret of the Fifth Sunday after Epiphany in the 1962 Roman Missal, also used when its formulary is resumed after Pentecost. The proper pages print the body and short Per Dominum cue. The full conclusion and Amen are a separate RG115a expansion with declared house orthography.

seg.tr: We offer You, O Lord, offerings of atonement, so that You may mercifully absolve our sins and Yourself guide our faltering hearts. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: We offer You, Lord, offerings of atonement
so that You may both mercifully absolve our faults
